decisions.rationale: Roughly 29% of pay is commission with a short contract history, and the letter's base salary ($96,176) does not match the pay stub base (about $70,600), so income needs review despite NOA support.
An unexplained $31,080 cash deposit on 16/06/2026 is undocumented, and without it funds fall below the $149,000 down payment.
Appraisal from an approved panel firm supports the price but is dated 27-Mar-2026, about four months before review, so recency is unclear.
Fixed-term contract renewed since Feb 2025 (about 17 months) is a short history for a stable-history test, and the letter salary conflicts with the pay stub.
Worksheet GDS 38.3% and TDS 43.5% are just inside limits but rely on variable-income-based $99,000 income that is not firmly verified.
